summary: Wintergreen Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a promissory note issued to its sponsor, MACRO DREAM Holdings Limited, for $184,635 to fund a trust-account extension for its initial business combination deadline. The note is unsecured, non-interest-bearing, convertible at $10.00 per unit at sponsor option, and forgivable if no deal closes. This is a routine SPAC extension funding mechanism, not a special-situation event. Watch for future business combination announcements or liquidation if no deal is completed.
